      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendPurchaseOrder" name="Send purchase order" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForDelivery" name="Wait for product delivery" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveInvoice" name="Receive invoice" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approve" sourceRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveRequest" name="Approve" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R1" sourceRef="Task_RejectRequest" targetRef="Task_SendNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R2" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R3" sourceRef="Task_AskForChange" targetRef="Task_ReviewChangeComments" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R4" sourceRef="Task_ReviewChangeComments" targetRef="Gateway_SupervisorDecision" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R5" sourceRef="Task_ApproveRequest" targetRef="SubProcess_Quotation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R6" sourceRef="SubProcess_Quotation" targetRef="Task_GeneratePurchaseOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R7" sourceRef="Task_GeneratePurchaseOrder" targetRef="Task_SendPurchaseOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R8" sourceRef="Task_SendPurchaseOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitForDelivery" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R9" sourceRef="Task_WaitForDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_R10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" targetRef="Task_SendNotification" />

  </bpmn:process>
